heading.en: Christ will be born of Mary—He will loose the bands of death and bear the sins of His people—Those who repent, are baptized, and keep the commandments will have eternal life—Filthiness cannot inherit the kingdom of God—Humility, faith, hope, and charity are required. About 83 B.C.
heading.sm: O le a fanau mai Keriso ia Maria—O le a ia tatalaina fusi o le oti ma tauave agasala a Ona tagata—O i latou o e salamo, ma papatisoina, ma tausi i poloaiga o le a maua e i latou le ola e faavavau—E le mafai e se mea eleelea ona mautofi i le malo o le Atua—E manaomia le lotomaualalo, faatuatua, faamoemoe, ma le alofa mama. E tusa o le 83 T.L.M.

w.en: that it has been made known
it shall be the last day
